arabic text: MAQTAL SE YEHI AATI THI SADA\nKOI NA RAHA SANNATA HAI
english translation text: Only this cry came from the battlefield:\nNo one remains; there is only silence.

arabic text: PARDES MEI AAKAR KAUN LUTA\nKOI NA RAHA SANNATA HAI
english translation text: Who came into exile and was plundered?\nNo one remains; there is only silence.

arabic text: ALLAH YE KAISA MANZAR HAI\nJO LAASH BHI HAI WO BE-SAR HAI\nBEHTA HAIO YAHA KHUN KA DARIYA...KOI
english translation text: O Allah, what a scene this is!\nEvery body lies without a head.\nA river of blood flows here—no one remains.

arabic text: YE LAASH HAI KIS SHEHZAADE KI\nKIS TARHA HUWA SEENA ZAKHMI\nQISMAT NE YE GHUM KISS MAA KO DIYA...KOI
english translation text: Whose young prince is this body?\nHow was his chest so terribly wounded?\nTo which mother has fate given this grief? No one remains.

arabic text: HAI QAD ME BARABAR DO LAASHE\nDUBI HAI LAHU KE DARIYA MEIN\nDONO KO AJALNE LUT LIYA...KOI
english translation text: Two bodies of equal height lie here,\nsubmerged in a river of blood.\nDeath has taken them both—no one remains.

arabic text: YE MAARA GAYA HAI KAUN HAZIN\nSEHRA HAI KAHIN KANGNA HAI KAHIN\nKAISA YE SITAM DUNIYA NE KIYA...KOI
english translation text: Who is this sorrowful youth who has been killed?\nHis wedding crown lies here, and his bracelet there.\nWhat cruelty has the world committed? No one remains.

arabic text: TURBAT HAI YAHA EK NANNI IS\nNAZDEEK PADAA HAI NAAWAK BHI\nMASOOM KO KISNE QATLE KIYA...KOI
english translation text: Here is the tiny grave of an infant,\nand nearby lies an arrow.\nWho murdered this innocent child? No one remains.

arabic text: HAR SIMTE UDAASI CHAAYI HAI\nTEERON PE KISSE NEENDH AAYI HAI\nBE GORO KAFAN LAASHA HAI PARAA...KOI
english translation text: Sadness has spread in every direction.\nWho has fallen asleep upon the arrows?\nA body lies without grave or shroud—no one remains.
